faq.question: Q1. What is CIHTS Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CIHTS Faculty Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies, Sarnath, Varanasi for faculty positions in Academic and Research Departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CIHTS Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 59 faculty vacancies are available, including Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in CIHTS Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for CIHTS Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CIHTS Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹57,700 to ₹2,18,200 depending on the faculty post and academic pay level.
